source_read: Live authenticated browser; Alan Chen's automatic translation switched back to Chinese. Full Musk original and Melvin parent read.
media: Alan Chen and Musk posts contain no attached images or videos. Parent charts are not selected for this standalone adaptation. No relevant video found.

evidence.type: Firsthand reporter account of CXMT president's conference announcement
evidence.supports: Reported year-end 2026 target for DDR5 RDIMM using 4F²; density motivation. Launch target is not proof of volume shipments, yields or cost.
Company reports G5 and 24Gb LPDDR5X mass production. This does not establish mass production for the new 4F² server product.
Company reports commercial LPDDR6 mass production. No scores or performance percentages from the announcement are used.
Latest listed official website announcements at review time concern G5 and LPDDR6; a dedicated 4F² release was not found. The post therefore uses reportedly.
Manufacturing scale analogy; caveat that RAM may differ; LP5/LP6 and harder HBM/logic stacking/cooling challenges. Treated as Musk's view, not independent evidence of yields or future price moves.

editorial_decisions: New standalone English post for @LeoGuoLabs, text only.
Pricing-power implication is conditional analysis, not a trading recommendation or prediction of immediate oversupply.
Omit stock movement percentages and causal attribution, capacity forecasts, DRAM market shares, claimed two-year technology lead, and unrelated SpaceX comments.
HBM is also standardized; distinction is manufacturing and integration difficulty, not standards versus proprietary products.
No unsolicited intermediary attribution, hashtags, public production notes or decorative graphic.
